Headline: Brown Line Service Delayed at Western
ShortDescription: Brown Line trains are standing at Western due to a mechanical problem. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Brown Line trains are standing at Western due to a mechanical problem.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:
#81 Lawrence
#80 Irving Park
#152 Addison

Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
